# KKCTools — Free Online Construction & Creative Calculators
> https://www.kkctools.com

KKCTools provides 100% free, fast, browser-side construction, landscaping, framing, and creative calculation utilities. All tools compute calculations entirely on the client side with zero network tracking, no registration required, and high accuracy for contractors, builders, landscapers, and DIY homeowners.

## Core Calculators & Tools

- [Band Name Generator](https://www.kkctools.com/band-name-generator/): Free random band name generator with genre and naming style filtering.
- [Construction Estimate Template](https://www.kkctools.com/construction-estimate-template/): Professional construction cost estimation builder with PDF/CSV export.
- [Asphalt Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/asphalt-calculator/): Calculates tons, cubic yards, and material cost for driveways, parking lots, and roads.
- [Topsoil Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/topsoil-calculator/): Estimates cubic yards, tons, and bags of topsoil needed for lawns and garden beds.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/gravel-calculator/): Converts driveway and pathway dimensions to tons, cubic yards, and bags of gravel.
- [Mulch Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/mulch-calculator/): Estimates bulk cubic yards, tons, and bags of mulch for landscaping beds with settling factors.
- [Square Footage Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/square-footage-calculator/): Calculates total square footage for single or multi-room layouts with material cost estimation.
- [Cinder Block Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/cinder-block-calculator/): Calculates standard CMU blocks, core fill concrete, and mortar bags for masonry walls.
- [Brick Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/brick-calculator/): Estimates modular and standard brick quantities, mortar bags, and total wall cost.
- [Paint Cost Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/paint-cost-calculator/): Computes gallons of primer and paint required for interior rooms and exterior siding.
- [Tile Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/tile-calculator/): Determines tile box count, square footage, grout bags, and mortar for floors and walls.
- [Laminate Flooring Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/laminate-flooring-calculator/): Multi-room laminate plank calculator with waste factor and underlayment rolls.
- [Stone Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/stone-calculator/): Aggregate, rock, and crushed stone calculator for beds, driveways, and drainage.
- [Stud Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/stud-calculator/): Wall framing calculator estimating studs, top/bottom plates, headers, and labor.
- [Tons to Cubic Yards Converter](https://www.kkctools.com/tons-to-cubic-yards/): Two-way bulk density converter between US short tons and cubic yards for 12+ construction materials.
- [Linear Foot Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/linear-foot-calculator/): Converts board feet and dimensions to total linear feet for trim, fences, and lumber.
- [Fill Dirt Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/fill-dirt-calculator/): Determines cubic yards and tons of fill dirt required for holes, grading, and foundation backfill.
- [Rafter Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/rafter-calculator/): Computes rafter length, birdsmouth cuts, pitch, and roof framing lumber quantities.
- [Sand Calculator](https://www.kkctools.com/sand-calculator/): Estimates tons and cubic yards of masonry, concrete, and paver sand.
